notes.title: Demo version 1.1.1 of “Dolls Nest” is now available.
notes.notes:
The demo version released in February 2025 has been re-released with some adjustments. 

Demo version Ver1.1.1 allows you to play until you clear the first stage.



*CAUTION

Some specifications are different from the full game version.

The saved data cannot be carried over to the full game version.  

Save data from the demo version released in February 2025 can still be used, but in some cases, problems may occur. In that case, please delete the save data from the demo version and play again.

notes.title: NITRO PLUS' new PC game "Dolls Nest" set to be release on April 24, 2025!
notes.notes:
The release date for the 3D Customization Action game "Dolls Nest," planned and conceived by NITRO ARTS, a CG team affiliated with NITRO PLUS, has been set for April 24, 2025!（JST）

Additionally, if you purchase the game by May 23, 2025, you will receive a bonus early purchase of the "Dolls Nest ArtWorks" setting material collection, which contains many of the designs that inspired the game, such as weapon and equipment design drawings and image boards.

▼ Dolls Nest ArtWorks 
Distribution period : April 24 to May 23, 2025（JST）
Number of pages : 49 pages
Format : png
※Purchase of “Dolls Nest” is required to download this content.
※If downloaded within this period, you will be able to continue to enjoy the content afterwards.

If you like, please purchase it during the applicable period!

In addition, the Main PV was also released along with the announcement of the release date. Please check it out!

[previewyoutube=XJZ-VX4QSw8;full][/previewyoutube]

NITRO PLUS is bringing you "Dolls Nest" with a lot of attention to detail. Please look forward to its release in April.

▼PC Game "Dolls Nest"
Release : April 24, 2025（JST）
Genre : 3D Customization Action
Price：$19.99 USD

notes.title: Demo version of “Dolls Nest” is now available.
notes.notes:
In the Demo version, you can play the tutorial and the beginning of the story.
The demo version will be available for a limited time until March 30, 2025.

We have also decided to participate in the Steam Next Fest starting on February 24th!
If you are interested or considering purchasing, please give it a try.

※Some specifications are different from the full game version.
※The saved data cannot be carried over to the full game version.

notes.title: Announcement of “Doll's Nest” release postponed [from 2024 to Spring 2025]
notes.notes:
In order to further improve the quality of the PC game “Dolls Nest,” which was scheduled for release in 2024, we have decided to postpone the release date to the spring of 2025.
We apologize to all those who have been looking forward to the release of “Dolls Nest” and ask for your understanding in this matter.
